howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Register your business in the QR-Helper service.
howItWorks.step2: Get ready-made printed packages of QR-code stickers to place in your venue in a visible spot.
howItWorks.step3: Your clients scan the QR codes and can:

step3Items.wifi: quickly connect to the Wi-Fi access point;
step3Items.feedback: send reviews and suggestions to your email or via SMS;
step3Items.google: leave reviews and ratings via Google;
step3Items.socials: quickly find your pages on social media;
step3Items.pay: pay contactless and fast for goods and services;
step3Items.car: scan the QR code on the car window to call you fast;
step3Items.site: open your website and YouTube channel;
step3Items.olx: open your OLX page with all your goods.

howItWorks.step4: As a result, the client saves both their time and yours.

faq.q1: What are QR-code stickers and why does my business need them?
faq.a1: These are ready-made printed stickers with a QR code containing your data: links to socials, Wi-Fi, phone, payment and more. The client points their smartphone camera and instantly performs the action — no manual typing.
faq.q2: Does the client need a special app?
faq.a2: No. The camera of any modern smartphone scans QR codes. For older phones there is a sticker linking to a free QR scanner.
faq.q3: How is a standard sticker different from a custom template?
faq.a3: Standard is a ready-made service layout where only your QR code and text change. A custom template (+100 UAH) lets you tune the colors of the text, background, frame and the QR code itself to match your brand.
faq.q4: How fast will I get my order?
faq.a4: After payment we produce the stickers and ship them by Nova Poshta — roughly within 24 hours.
faq.q5: Can I order just a few kinds of stickers?
faq.a5: Yes. Add only the stickers you need to your order — one is enough.
faq.q6: What if the data changes (Wi-Fi password, phone number)?
faq.a6: The QR code is generated from your data, so a change requires a new sticker. Just place a new order with the updated data.
